description: This PHP file defines a custom widget class 'SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectButton' extending 'SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton', providing a button UI component for selecting items in a subpanel, with methods for rendering the button and handling its properties within the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a 'Select' button in subpanels, allowing user interaction to select related records.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the widget with specific button properties.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for the widget, appending 'select_button'.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the label for the button, typically 'Select'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the HTML for the button, considering permissions and context, and prepares data for popup selection.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the localized title for the button.

methods.name: getAccesskey
methods.description: Returns the localized access key for the button.
